payload.instance: uuid — the battlemap instance the token stands on, when the command names no target; never written
payload.token: uuid — the NPC token whose current HP change, a token of that instance (instance-isolated); never written, the change lands on the token's own row alone, never on another token of the same character (hp-change-one-token)
payload.delta: integer — the damage, negative, or the healing, positive; the HP land between 0 and the token's HP max (pj-hp-not-tracked), and at 0 the token is dead, derived from its HP alone (dead-derived). A PC's token tracks no HP: the change is rejected
